title: multiplexd Protocol Hello Message
description: Wire format for the hello message exchanged during session handshake (spec §5.2.2).

type.description: MIME media type string; must parse as application/x-multiplexd-proto with parameter version=1 (spec §5.2.2).

session_id.description: 24-character Base64 (RFC 4648 standard alphabet, with padding) encoding of the 16-byte server-assigned session identity (spec §5.2.2).

resume_seq.description: Number of the peer's non-stream-0 frames processed by this endpoint; used for session resumption (spec §5.7, §5.8).

extensions.description: Extension negotiation object; absent is treated as {} (spec §5.2.2). Unrecognised keys MUST be silently ignored.

reject_inbound.description: When true, the sender cannot accept new inbound streams (spec §5.2.3.1).

identity.description: UTF-8 identity claim; maximum 255 octets, NUL character excluded (spec §5.2.3.2).
